name: Kisan Parivahan Yojana
benefit: **Name of the Component****Standard of Assistance (For Small, Marginal, Women, SC/ST Farmers)****Standard of Assistance (For General/Other Farmers)**Medium-sized goods vehicles (capacity of 600kg to 1500 kg)35% of the total vehicle cost or ₹75,000/-, whichever is lower25% of the total vehicle cost or ₹50,000/-, whichever is lower> **Note:** - **Minimum Time Limit for Reclaiming Benefits:*
_eligibility_text:
- The applicant must be a farmer.
- The applicant must belong to the Gujarat state.
- The applicant must purchase a medium-sized goods vehicle (600kg to 1500kg capacity) from an [authorized dealer](https://ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in/Public/frm_Public_DealerDetails.aspx).
